choices.why: The white three-seat sofa with track arms and light birch legs is the most Scandinavian option, and it keeps the long left wall bright and airy against the white walls.
The cognac leather bentwood chair adds the warmth the user asked for, its curved frame is a Nordic classic, and the leather echoes the warm oak floor near the balcony.
At 180x224 cm it is large enough to sit under the front of both the sofa and the armchair in this long room, and its natural beige and taupe stripes bring warmth rather than stark contrast.
The large, low round walnut table fits the scale of a three-seat sofa in this big room, and its warm wood ties the leather chair and the oak floor together.

answer.why: A white sofa on light wood legs, a cognac leather bentwood chair, a natural striped rug and a walnut table layer light, airy Nordic basics with warm wood and leather tones. Together they suit the white walls, oak floor and black window frames and give the warm Nordic living room the user asked for.
